# A test reaches its instance through a local holding it and through a
# function it hands the instance to, on every target: a trigger, a null test,
# a state read and a one-way prop read, through the instance and through a
# component it renders. testdata/test_instance_reach.txtar is the code.

sngl test --platform=none app.sngl
stdout 'ok   2 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=html app.sngl
stdout 'ok   2 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=bubbletea --language=go app.sngl
stdout 'ok   2 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=fyne --language=go app.sngl
stdout 'ok   2 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=gtk4 --language=go app.sngl
stdout 'ok   2 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=android --language=kotlin app.sngl
stdout 'ok   2 tests, 0 failures'

-- app.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "sngl:test"

output {
    go {
        bubbletea
        fyne
        gtk4
    }
    kotlin {
        android
    }
    none {
        html
    }
}

component badge(label string) node {
    var hits = 0
    button #hit(text="{label}{hits}", @click { hits = hits + 1 })
}

component main node {
    var shown = true
    var hits = 0
    vbox {
        button #ts(text="s", @click { shown = !shown })
        text #label(value="n{hits}")
        badge #bd(label="b")
        if shown {
            button #k(text="k{hits}", @click { hits = hits + 1 })
        }
    }
}

func clickK(c main) {
    if c.k != null {
        c.k.click()
    }
}

func clickTwice(c main) {
    clickK(c)
    clickK(c)
}

func hitBadge(b badge, times int) {
    var i = 0
    for i < times {
        b.hit.click()
        i = i + 1
    }
}

func shownK(c main) => c.k != null

func labelOf(c main) => c.label.value

func testAlias(t Test, c main) {
    var held = c
    t.assert(held.k != null)
    if held.k != null {
        held.k.click()
    }
    t.assert(held.hits == 1)
    t.assert(held.label.value == "n1")
    var b = held.bd
    b.hit.click()
    t.assert(b.hits == 1)
    t.assert(held.bd.hits == 1)
    held.ts.click()
    t.assert(held.k == null)
}

func testHelpers(t Test, c main) {
    clickK(c)
    t.assert(c.hits == 1)
    clickTwice(c)
    t.assert(c.hits == 3)
    t.assert(shownK(c))
    t.assert(labelOf(c) == "n3")
    hitBadge(c.bd, 2)
    t.assert(c.bd.hits == 2)
    c.ts.click()
    t.assert(!shownK(c))
}

window {
    main
}
